# Failure Report — `<FAILURE_ID>`

> Copy to `docs/failures/<FAILURE_ID>.md`.
> Failures are findings. Do not delete a failure because it is inconvenient.

| Failure ID | |

| Category | technical bug / data problem / scientific ambiguity / safety issue |
| Severity | low / medium / high / safety-critical |
| Status | open / mitigated / resolved / accepted |

## Root cause

Evidence-based. Do not write "feature X caused it" unless evidence establishes that;
prefer "the observed shift is consistent with ...".
